entities.summary: Murong Xuecun is the pen name of the Chinese writer Hao Qun (郝群). His debut work Leave Me Alone: A Novel of Chengdu, which was distributed online, propelled him to stardom. On July 22, 2008, Murong made the long list for the Man Asian Literary Prize.
